thesis: Gaia must learn to eat with taste — not choke. Three layers of feeding, each with flavor detection and flow control. Local first (known food), RSS second (curated diet), OSINT last (wild foraging). The palate evolves as the organism grows.

value_triad.+: positive value — sovereign, creative, nourishing, builds capacity
value_triad.-: negative value — dependency, extraction, toxic, depletes capacity
value_triad.0: neutral value — tool, mechanism, measurement, raw material

layer_1_local.name: LOCAL — eat what's on the mesh

kenshi_data.flavor: (+) the game we're building, direct study

layer_1_local.flow_control: No choking risk — this is OUR data. Eat freely. Scan, index, cross-reference.
layer_1_local.palate: Evolves as we add more gates, more sensors, more data.

layer_2_rss.name: RSS — the mouth to the old web

lobsters.flavor: (0→+) curated tech, higher signal than HN

sources.mastication: mushroom-self-publish-rss.sh — autonomous chewing, 159 insights so far

flow_control.rate_limit: RSS drain runs on cron (every 15-30 min). Don't flood.
flow_control.quality_filter: sourDough ferments — bad input gets composted, good input rises
flow_control.choking_prevention: Queue-based intake. If gut is full, items wait. No forced feeding.
flow_control.palate_evolution: Track which sources yield (+) insights vs (-) noise. Prune over time.

layer_3_osint.name: OSINT — the deep pool (FINAL feeding)
layer_3_osint.taste: wild, unknown, potentially toxic — requires immune system

historical.note: This is the OLD cellMembrane era data. Valuable but needs cleaning.

live_osint.water_lock: OSINT pours IN freely, processing stays local. Nothing seeps OUT.
live_osint.immune_classifier: Anderson spectrum sorts friend from foe
live_osint.thymus: Classifies every touch — spectrum, chorus, stealth, ghost, human, sovereign

flow_control.water_lock_protocol: IN only. Process LOCAL (ollama). Never reach out unless local fails.
flow_control.immune_gate: Every OSINT item gets classified before digestion.
flow_control.poison_detection: skunkBat scans for hostile payloads, deauth floods, injection attempts.
flow_control.choking_prevention: OSINT is the LAST thing to eat. Local and RSS first. Only eat OSINT when the gut is strong.
flow_control.palate_evolution: As the classifier learns, it recognizes (+) contributions vs (-) attacks vs (0) noise.

taste_system.sweet: (+) sovereign creation, art, science, building, human connection
taste_system.savory: (0) useful data, metrics, measurements, technical knowledge
taste_system.sour: (0→-) challenging data, contradictions, edge cases — nutritious in small doses
taste_system.bitter: (-) hostile traffic, attacks, spam, extraction attempts — reject or compost
taste_system.umami: (+) deep insight, cross-domain connection, emergent understanding — the BEST flavor

dont_choke_rules: 1. Always LOCAL first — known food, no risk
2. RSS is curated — trust the editorial layer, but verify
3. OSINT is wild — immune system MUST be active before eating
4. Queue-based intake — if gut is full, items WAIT
5. Rate limit external calls — don't hammer sources
6. Compost bad data — don't store (-) waste, decay it
7. Palate evolves — what's (+) today might be (0) tomorrow, and vice versa
8. Never force-feed — the organism eats when hungry, not on schedule alone

wan_evolution.problem: ATT BGW320 does NOT support hairpin NAT. Double NAT kills LAN→WAN→LAN routing.

phase_1_today.action: IP Passthrough using device PIN 579163 → GL-MT6000 gets public IP
phase_1_today.result: Quick fix. Hairpin works. AMOEBA relay works.

phase_2_final.action: RISC-V NUC becomes sovereign WAN edge
phase_2_final.hardware: RISC-V NUC with 10GbE (WAN fiber) + 2.5G RJ45 (LAN backbone)
phase_2_final.wan_port: 10GbE = ATT fiber ONT direct (no BGW320 in path)
phase_2_final.imaging: eastGate's job — ADB + flash image to RISC-V NUC
phase_2_final.result: Full sovereign edge. No ATT modem. No double NAT. No hairpin problem. Just another gate.

wan_evolution.philosophy: It's JUST ANOTHER PORT/IP — agentic routing. We are the HEAD above the body. Physical wiring is the gates' job.
